jars: overthinking, procrastination, outcome_anxiety, restless_mind, resentment, guilt
The mind is not your enemy. It was never taught how to sit still, so it keeps running.
Karunya came home from his studies so full of questions that he stopped doing anything at all.
best: The mind is restless and hard to control. This is easier said than done. Your mind was never taught to rest, so it keeps running long after you have asked it to stop.
day1_verdict: Krishna saying the mind is restless but can be trained actually makes me feel like I'm not just a lazy idiot, which is a huge relief before exams.
